complaint.body: If you disagree with this resolution, you can submit a complaint through our internal complaint-handling system within 6 months (DSA Art. 20).

report.title: Report Illegal Content
report.intro: Under the Digital Services Act (DSA, Regulation EU 2022/2065), you have the right to notify us of content that you consider to be illegal. Your report will be processed in accordance with our notice-and-action procedure.
report.rightsAnonymous: You may submit reports anonymously by providing an email address for acknowledgment.
report.rightsAcknowledgment: You will receive an acknowledgment of your report without undue delay (DSA Art. 16(4)).
report.rightsDecision: You will be notified of the decision taken on your report.
report.rightsComplaint: If you disagree with a decision, you may submit a complaint through our internal complaint-handling system.
report.unfoundedNotice: DSA Art. 16(3)(d): Submitting manifestly unfounded notices may result in reporting restrictions under DSA Art. 23.

form.acknowledgmentNote: DSA Art. 16(4): You will receive an acknowledgment without undue delay.
form.title: Report Illegal Content
form.intro: DSA Art. 16 — Report content you believe is illegal or violates our terms. You may report anonymously by providing only your email.
form.targetIdLabel: ID or reference of the content
form.explanationHint: DSA Art. 16(3): Please explain in detail why you believe this content is illegal.
form.explanationPlaceholder: Please describe the content you are reporting and why you believe it is illegal...
form.emailNote: Required for anonymous reports. We will send you an acknowledgment and updates.
form.goodFaithLabel: I declare that this report is submitted in good faith and that the information provided is accurate to the best of my knowledge.
form.goodFaithNote: DSA Art. 16(3)(d): False or malicious reports may result in reporting restrictions under DSA Art. 23.
